commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== boot id baseline =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uptime -s || true

echo "== module status before =="
lsmod | grep -i usb_storage || echo "not loaded"

echo "== write modprobe blacklist =="
sudo -n tee /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
blacklist usb-storage
install usb-storage /bin/true
EOF
cat /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf

echo "== rebuild initramfs so blacklist applies at boot =="
if command -v dracut >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n dracut -f
elif command -v update-initramfs >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n update-initramfs -u
else
  echo "no initramfs tool found" >&2
fi

echo "== attempt to remove module now if loaded =="
if lsmod | grep -q '^usb_storage'; then
  sudo -n modprobe -r usb-storage || sudo -n rmmod usb_storage || echo "could not remove module now (may be in use)" >&2
else
  echo "usb_storage already not loaded"
fi

echo "== verify modprobe refuses to load it =="
sudo -n modprobe usb-storage -n -v || true
sudo -n modprobe usb-storage || echo "modprobe load returned nonzero (expected due to blacklist install true)"

echo "== final lsmod check =="
lsmod | grep -i usb_storage || echo "confirmed: usb_storage not loaded"
